subtopics.title: Development versus Growth — and How Development Is Measured

questions.question: Economic development differs from economic growth because development:
options: Tracks the quality of people's lives — health, education, poverty — not just output

questions.question: The three dimensions of the Human Development Index are:
South Africa's HDI ranking sits below its income ranking because:
options: Our GDP figures are not published
Life expectancy and learning outcomes lag behind what our income predicts

questions.question: Falling below the rand amount needed for minimum daily nutrition places a person under:
options: Absolute poverty — South Africa's food poverty line

subtopics.title: The Six Signs — Common Characteristics of Developing Countries

questions.question: The vicious circle of low productivity runs:
options: High wages, high savings, too much investment
Low productivity, low wages, low savings, little investment in tools — repeating
Low prices, high exports, high growth
High population, low exports, high wages

questions.question: A high dependency burden means:
options: Each working-age adult supports many dependants, leaving little to save

questions.question: On unemployment, South Africa is described as 'not typical but extreme' because:
options: Unemployment is below the world average
The official rate exceeds 30% and the expanded rate exceeds 40% — among the world's highest
The expanded definition excludes discouraged workers

questions.question: South Africa 'half-fits' primary-sector dependence because:
options: Production is service-dominated, but exports still lean heavily on minerals and metals

subtopics.title: Development Strategies — and South Africa's Succession of Plans

questions.question: An inward-looking strategy that protects home industries with tariffs is called:
The RDP's leading emphasis was:
options: Basic needs — houses, water, electricity, clinics delivered directly

questions.question: GEAR's record is summarised in the lesson as:
options: It ignored inflation and debt entirely
It steadied the finances, but jobs lagged

questions.question: The NDP 2030's headline targets include:
options: Eliminating income poverty and cutting unemployment to single digits by 2030

subtopics.title: Indigenous Knowledge Systems — Development from Within

questions.question: Indigenous Knowledge Systems are best defined as:
options: Knowledge, practices and institutions developed by communities over generations and passed on culturally
Knowledge published in scientific journals only

questions.question: The stokvel is offered as an example of indigenous:
options: Finance — rotating savings mobilising billions among people banks ignored

questions.question: Biopiracy means:
options: Profiting from indigenous knowledge without consent or compensation — as happened with hoodia

questions.question: The rooibos agreement matters because it:
options: Proved IKS has no commercial value
Replaced the tea industry with mining
Recognised Khoi and San communities as traditional knowledge holders who now earn a share

subtopics.title: Taller or Better? — What Development Actually Asks

questions.question: In the child analogy, growth is the tape measure and development is:
options: Everything the tape cannot see — health, learning, capability

questions.question: A clinic and better-staffed school improving life before incomes move is an example of:
South Africa's development score-sheet in one sentence is:
options: Richer than we are healthy or educated
Equal on all three HDI dimensions

subtopics.title: The Six Signs, Walked Down One Street

questions.question: The man digging with a spade beside an idle machine illustrates:
'One gogo's pension feeding many people' is the street version of:
'Selling raw, buying made' describes an economy that:
options: Exports unprocessed resources and imports finished goods, earning the smallest slice

questions.question: South Africa's 'twist' on low standard of living is that:
options: Average income is low but equally shared
The average looks comfortable while the spread hides deep poverty
Only rural areas have high incomes

subtopics.title: Plans on Paper, Roots in the Ground

questions.question: The correct order of South Africa's big plans is:
The lesson's honest report card on the plans reads:
options: Services delivered and floor held; growth and jobs repeatedly missed

questions.question: In a stokvel, members:
options: Borrow from a commercial bank jointly
Contribute monthly and take turns receiving the pooled amount

questions.question: 'Smart development joins the two' means policy should:
options: Replace stokvels and healers with formal institutions only
Build on trusted indigenous institutions — riding on stokvels, working with healers, planting proven crops
Patent indigenous knowledge for the state
